description: PhyLatent task demonstrations and Cube diagnostic comparisons.
notes: Demonstrations illustrate behavior; they are not aggregate benchmark results.
Future images are simulator observations; the model predicts latent states.
Distinguishability diagnosis and paired planning use different initial states; planning success does not establish recovery of that diagnostic.
The counterfactual comparison includes an additional action proposal that was not in the original LeWM candidate pool.
Paired executions use the same physical initial state and goal; each model selects its own actions.
The distinguishability planning comparison uses a wider display camera rendered from the recorded states.
